form:FormGroup.label: Element
form:FormGroup.helpText: The pipeline element that this property relates to.

form:FormGroup.label: Name
form:FormGroup.helpText: The name of the property on this pipeline element.

form:FormGroup.label: Source
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Default, Inherit, Local, or Embedded for some document properties.

form:HelpHTML.p: The source of the value for this property.

ul.li: Default means the default value is used.
Inherit means the value is inherited from the parent pipeline.
Local means the value set on this element is used.
Embedded means a new document is created and embedded in this pipeline, rather than referencing an existing document. Only offered for some document properties.

form:FormGroup.label: Value
form:FormGroup.helpText: The value of this property. Changing it sets Source to Local.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Changing it sets Source to Local.

form:FormGroup.label: Default Value
form:FormGroup.helpText: The default value for this property on this pipeline element type.

form:FormGroup.label: Inherited Value
form:FormGroup.helpText: The value inherited from the parent pipeline.
